reuse.why: Builds on the existing findOrCreateLinkedAccount/assertBankAccountNotLinked layer in link.ts and extracts clearAccountLink so unlinkAccount and the takeover share it; the holder lookup query is written again rather than shared with the assert.

duplication.why: The unlink field reset is shared, but unlinkAccountsHoldingBankAccount repeats assertBankAccountNotLinked's holder SELECT verbatim.

placement.why: The takeover lives in accounts/link.ts, the module that already owns link guards and account linking, and runs after the closed-account check; app.ts only forwards the flag.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing, the link helpers, the unlink refactor and targeted tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Clear separation of the takeover from the refusal and a single unlink definition; the flag must still be forwarded by hand through each provider wrapper, and the holder query exists twice.
